First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:00 am. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
Expect 20+ mph on average: fast — for riders who race or train.
Check
Look at @whitetailbikes the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Saturday Road Shop Ride group ride

Saturday Road Shop Ride is a road group ride in Milton, GA. It rolls every Saturday at 8:00 am from Whitetail Bicycles & Coffee Company.

A long, fast Saturday road ride from the Whitetail shop in Milton, 60 to 70 miles at a 20+ mph average. Coffee shop on site.
